technique_name: Describe an ideal vacation for the given person.
description: For someone looking to relax and embrace their love of the outdoors, an ideal vacation would be a weeklong hiking and camping trip in the Rocky Mountains. On the way, they would stop to explore the local towns and attractions along the route, so that they can take in the culture and enjoy the local sights. example: Someone who needs to relax and is an outdoor enthusiast.
